prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1338; do not mention it.)
text:
This summary describes the course of care for a patient presenting with cervical and lumbar strain following a motor vehicle collision. The patient reported neck pain radiating into the trapezius region and low back pain with stiffness, both occurring after the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left at an intersection. Initial examination revealed reduced range of motion in the cervical spine, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and guarding of the lumbar region. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no reported numbness or weakness in the upper or lower extremities.

Treatment over the course of 16 visits included manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise for core and cervical stabilization, heat and cold modalities, and a home exercise program. Pain levels were tracked at each visit and showed steady improvement, with the patient reporting a reduction from moderate to mild symptoms by the midpoint of care. Range of motion improved in both the cervical and lumbar regions, and the patient demonstrated improved tolerance for daily activities and driving.

At discharge, the patient was ambulatory without restriction, with residual mild stiffness reported only after prolonged sitting. Continued self-directed home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
